Oura's IPO prospectus, filed 21 September, sets a $40–$44 range that tops out valuing the ring maker at $14.12bn — above Prada, on the document's own post-offering share count. Existing stockholders are selling 73% of the offering; Eli Lilly and Dragoneer have pre-committed $400m combined. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Sotheby's Hong Kong Fine Jewelry sale made HK$58.8m on 294 lots, Rapaport reports — the sale's own page carries no total. A 44.90-carat Ceylon sapphire pendant led at 2.57 times its high estimate; pink diamond earrings, sold without reserve, made 0.60 times theirs. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
